row.evidence: Salesloft's help centre documents SCIM provisioning only through its Okta app ("Adheres to the SCIM 2.0 specifications with the core user schema"), and the article's Package Availability icon marks it available on both current packages, Advanced and Elite.
row.notes: Status changed from June (gated): Salesloft repackaged in September 2025 into two packages, Advanced and Elite, both Contact Sales (/pricing now redirects to a Talk to Sales page). The Package Availability icon on the Okta provisioning, SSO and Deactivate Users articles shows both packages ticked, so SCIM and SSO are on the base package; this comes from an image on the help article, not text. SCIM is documented only for Okta (OIN app: SAML + SCIM Create/Update/Deactivate, no group push); Entra, Google and OneLogin get SAML SSO only, so the row is partial. June's Essentials ~$125 / Premier ~$180 prices were third-party and are dropped; Essentials and Premier are now legacy. Drift (part of Salesloft) has its own Okta apps; Drift Email supports Okta SCIM create/update/delete with SWA sign-on.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: SSO/SCIM availability from the Package Availability icon (image) on the help articles.

auth.token_source: accounts.salesloft.com > Your Applications > API Key (admin user; scopes groups:write, team:delete, team:read, team:write)

endpoints.notes: Endpoints are used by the Okta app only; no public SCIM endpoint reference.

operations.notes: Okta 'Update User Attributes' is supported; method not documented. Group membership is set by a Salesloft Group ID attribute, not group push.

deprovision.data_retained: Inactive users keep their previous group and role; Cadences and Person ownership must be reassigned.
deprovision.notes: Deactivation removes the user from their Salesloft license and access, but the docs do not say the paid seat is credited.

custom.how: Custom Roles, license assignment and group assignment are pushed as user attributes from Okta.

attributes.notes: Only 'core user schema' is stated; individual attribute names are not listed.

roles.how: Custom Roles and license assignment as Okta user attributes (Salesloft Enterprise app); legacy app did not include roles/groups.

limitations.text: Email address (username) updates are not supported; editing it in the legacy app deactivates and recreates the user.
No group push from Okta (nested groups not supported).
SCIM documented only for Okta; Entra uses a non-gallery SAML app.

endpoints.purpose: Fetch a user by ID or GUID

audit_log_api.notes: Audit reports are requested asynchronously and then fetched.

rate_limits.text: 600 cost points per minute, with higher costs for deep page numbers.

okta.notes: OIN app shows SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate checked (rendered page).

entra.notes: Salesloft documents a non-gallery SAML app; no Entra tutorial (salesloft-tutorial 404). A Drift Entra tutorial exists for Drift chat.

fallbacks.notes: Drift Email offers Okta SCIM (create/update/delete, password sync) with SWA sign-on; Drift chat has its own Okta app with SAML/SWA/SCIM.
